You can browse live availability and compare listings using the Apartments.com Austin Guide or search thousands of options on Zillow Austin Rentals. 
Austin Apartment Market Overview
  • Average Rent: Around $1,413 to $1,560 per month, depending on the platform and neighborhood, which sits slightly below the national average.
  • Studio Prices: Typically start around $856 to $1,222+ per month.
  • 1-Bedroom Prices: Generally average $1,250 to $1,491+ per month.
  • 2-Bedroom Prices: Range around $1,695 to $3,385+ per month. 
Popular Neighborhoods & Communities
  • Downtown / Central: High-rise and luxury living options like Gables Republic Square,
    The Catherine, and Northshore Apartments.
  • East Austin: Vibrant, walkable communities such as Windsor Commons, Trailhead, and Avenir Apartments.
  • South Austin: Popular spots near SoCo and major corridors like The Bennett and SOFI at 6311. 
If you'd like to narrow down your search, tell me:
  • What is your target monthly budget?
  • Which neighborhood or side of town do you prefer?
  • What number of bedrooms do you need?
